QuestInfo.name: Yoona's Quiz on Shopping : Start
QuestInfo.0: I should meet Yoona at Southperry for a little quiz!
QuestInfo.1: There's a quest before the quiz starts. I better take care of that fast.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to safely obtain Beginner's Guide to Shopping at the Cash Shop.

0.0: Hi, you must be a first-timer here! Would you like to participate in a Shopping Quiz?

yes.0: First, before you start solving the questions, it'll be best for you to experience the Cash Shop firsthand. As long as you keep your composure and answer these questions with a steady hand, you'll be fine. The Beginner's Shopping Guide can be purchased at the Cash Shop for 1 meso, so go get your copy now! The Cash Shop can be found at the bottom right corner of the screen.

no.0: That's fine. If you ever change your mind, let me know.

1.0: Wow, that was fast. I think you have mastered the ins and outs of shopping. I think you're more than qualified to take on the Shopping Quiz!

yes.0: Are you ready to answer the questions?

item.0: Oh no, you haven't found The Beginner's Guide to Shopping? It's on sale right now, so find it!
